turn.user_message: Consultants finish rounds by about 11. The RMO drafts the summary, the consultant signs, and a transcriptionist types it up. We’re 250 beds, around 88% full, 40–45 discharges a day.
turn.context: Discharge sample conversation, turn 2 (playbook §1.2: put a price on the wait before the diagnosis).

transcript.label: Sample conversation · turn 2 · price the wait

text: Thank you. That is the first stop done. Three people handle every summary, and none of it starts before 11.
To put a price on the wait, I need three figures. They are on the bill in the drawing.
chat.pointer: Type each figure straight onto the bill. Each one goes into your message.
chat.note: A delay only moves people once it has a price.
